title: Bright Mountain Media, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: Bright Mountain Media, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the Twenty-Fifth Amendment to its Senior Secured Credit Agreement with Centre Lane Partners, effective March 31, 2026. The amendment deferred a $1.2 million principal installment to December 20, 2026, converted approximately $201,000 in interest to paid-in-kind, and required the company to notify lenders of changes to key vendor agreements. As consideration, the company issued 2,922,566 shares of common stock (1.5% of fully-diluted ownership) to Centre Lane Partners, raising their beneficial ownership to approximately 27.3%.
key_points: Twenty-Fifth Amendment to the Senior Secured Credit Agreement effective March 31, 2026, with Centre Lane Partners as Administrative and Collateral Agent.
Quarterly principal installment of approximately $1.2 million due March 31, 2026 deferred in its entirety to December 20, 2026.
Interest of approximately $201,000 on Second Out Loans converted to paid-in-kind rather than cash payment.
Company issued 2,922,566 shares of common stock (par value $0.01) to Centre Lane Partners as consideration for the amendment.
Centre Lane Partners and affiliates now beneficially own approximately 27.3% of common stock following the issuance.
Approximately $1.6 million due June 30, 2026 and approximately $92.1 million due at maturity on December 20, 2026.
why_it_matters: This filing is a micro-cap corporate credit amendment with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. Bright Mountain Media is a private Florida-based media company with no exchange-listed securities. Centre Lane Partners is a private credit fund. The credit agreement amendment defers a $1.2M payment and converts ~$201K interest to PIK — this has no systemic market implications.
